Clicking the orange square at (12, 27) changed gameplay:
- G(1) at (14, 25) became W(1) at (14, 25) - the dark gray pixel near the orange square turned white
- W(29) at (35, 0) became W(27) at (37, 0) - the HUD element changed
So clicking the orange square turned the adjacent dark gray pixel to white. This is similar to what happened when I clicked the purple square earlier - it turned an adjacent dark gray pixel white.
So the mechanic for Level 2 seems to be:
1. Click the colored square → turns adjacent dark gray pixel to white (creating a trail)
2. Click the magenta → moves the square along the path
3. Click the colored center in the dark gray diamond → swaps the diamond to white
But the squares still aren't moving when I click magenta. Let me think about this differently.
Actually, wait. Let me re-examine what happened with the purple square:
1. I clicked purple center at (35, 45) → dark gray diamond at (33, 45) became white
2. I clicked magenta at (41, 49) → purple square moved from (39, 48) to (42, 50)
3. I clicked magenta at (44, 51) → purple square moved from (42, 50) to (44, 51)
The purple square DID move! It moved 2 steps. But then it got stuck because the path ahead was blocked or the mechanic changed.
For the orange square:
1. I clicked orange center at (9, 49) → dark gray diamond at (7, 49) became white
2. I clicked magenta at (14, 28) → diamond swapped back but square didn't move
The orange square didn't move. Why? Maybe because I needed to click the orange square FIRST to create a white trail, THEN click the magenta.
Looking at the current state, the orange square sits at (12, 27) with a white pixel now at (14, 25) after clicking it, while the magenta marker is at (14, 28). The purple square has progressed to (44, 51) with its magenta at (46, 52). I should try clicking the orange square again to extend its white trail further, then attempt to move it with the magenta click.
